_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v541_embed_50k/plan/runplan.pin.json (plan §3.2/§12.1). runplan.jsonl lists concrete runs; this pin freezes the preregistered run classes so diagnostic runs can never be counted in the main winner selection (§9.1).

nominal.description: T1 E1/E2/E3/E4 seed17 full-schedule; later T3 top-2 x {29,43}

conditional.description: T0-R matched E0 retrain x3 (only if training comparability fails); T2 E5 (only if E1+E4 parents pass H0/H1/H2 and budget approved); T3 preregistered candidate set E1-E5 x {29,43} — only the frozen inner-val top-2 (max 2 candidates x 2 seeds = 4 runs) activates

t3_preregistration.e5_gate_stack: E5 T3 rows stack parent_gate AND top2 selection gate

diagnostic.description: T4 capacity/depth controls (E0-MLP, E0-deeper); never enters Embedding-only winner competition
diagnostic.skip_rule: if E*=E0 with no new embedding gain -> gate_skipped(reason=no_new_embedding_gain)

core_training_count_formula: N_core = n_T1 + I(E5) + 2*n_selected + 3*I(E0_retrain); full nominal 8-9 (11-12 with E0 retrain); T4 diagnostics counted separately. The T3 block LISTS 10 preregistered candidate runs but only max 4 activate (2 frozen candidates x seeds 29/43); unactivated runs are gate_skipped with 0 new trainings. N_core is always computed from the formula, NEVER by summing listed run rows (plan §9.1).

shared_protocol.batch: 8 curves x 4 frames stratified start/pre-TS/post-TS/endpoint; (seed, update, salt) sampler protocol

_t1_block_rule: runplan_sha256 and code_commit must be non-null before formal T1 (§17 formal-run SHA freeze)
